// lint-expect: 0
// lint-as: internal/platform/auth/verify.go
// The proxy and decoder rules are gateway-only; the platform tree gets the read rule.

package auth

func decode(r *http.Request, v any) error {
	req, _ := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "http://x", r.Body)
	_ = req
	return json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(v)
}
